headline: Oracle cancels $7 billion Tencent AI data center deal after US pressure
summary: Oracle cancelled a $7 billion contract with Tencent that would have provided access to roughly 100,000 AI chips in Southeast Asian data centers over five years.
why: Geopolitical export controls and regulatory pressure on advanced technology infrastructure restrict cross-border cloud and AI chip deployments.

impacts.name: Oracle
impacts.why: Cancellation of a major $7 billion cloud contract directly impacts Oracle's international revenue projections.
